represented_relation: Each pipeline set position refers either to the active bound resources or to an empty placeholder needed only to preserve set numbering.
repair_relevant_fact: Placeholder set layouts preserve numbering without claiming active bindings or a second push-descriptor role.
decision_site: logical descriptor sets to native pipeline layout
candidate_check: Compare compiled requirements with runtime resources and capabilities before loading or execution.
repair_evidence: PR 10448 creates dummy layouts with zero bindings and enables the push-descriptor flag only when a layout contains at least one binding.

represented_relation: The task poller binds an execution wait to its list membership until completion retirement.
repair_relevant_fact: The poller removes every poller-owned reference before retirement publishes completion to the task owner.
candidate_check: Follow owners and references through the last use and verify one matching release.
repair_evidence: PR 11352 returns the retire status to the caller, erases the task from the wait list, retires it afterward, and clears the now-invalid local pointer.

represented_relation: The caching allocator binds a logical parameter and initial_data to a free-pool HAL buffer.
repair_relevant_fact: When the caller supplies initial_data, reuse writes those bytes successfully before publishing the buffer.
candidate_check: Check successful initialization before publishing storage or runtime state.
repair_evidence: Commit 7be84611 writes initial_data into an existing buffer, checks the write status, and returns the buffer only after successful initialization.

represented_relation: A binding number and byte offset jointly identify the physical subspan passed to each microkernel argument.

candidate_check: Compose every index and offset transformation and compare the resulting physical element or region.
repair_evidence: PR 12510 represents nonzero subspan offsets in strided memref metadata, preserves them during flattening, wires the passes into affected backends, and adds offset-sensitive tests.

represented_relation: The bytecode dispatcher binds encoded register ordinals to storage in the current VM stack frame.
repair_relevant_fact: After any call that can grow the VM stack, dispatch refreshes the current frame, register pointers, and program counter before decoding the next instruction.
decision_site: native import return to bytecode operand read
candidate_check: Compare logical identity, position, and role with the selected physical entity.
repair_evidence: PR 12809 restores regs_i32, regs_ref, and pc after every bytecode or import call that may have changed the stack.

represented_relation: The tensor-core strategy binds loop iterations, async copies, shared-memory stages, and mma.sync consumers.
repair_relevant_fact: Pipelining proceeds only when the schedule contains the required copies, waits, barriers, warp operations, and stage-separated buffers.
candidate_check: Require a dependency or synchronization edge between conflicting operations.
repair_evidence: PR 13971 makes the mma.sync schedule explicit, rejects incomplete scheduling ingredients, strengthens strategy validation, and adds conservative size and depth guards.

represented_relation: IREE HAL buffer views refer to logical buffers that can be subspans of concrete WebGPU allocations.

decision_site: logical subspan to physical allocation and native-handle transfer
candidate_check: Compare logical identity, position, and role with the selected physical entity.
repair_evidence: PR 14163 resolves a HAL buffer through iree_hal_buffer_allocated_buffer before casting it or placing it in a transfer command, retains the original subspan offset, resets the mapped readback offset to zero, and propagates asynchronous mapping errors.

represented_relation: LLVMCPU linking binds generated math calls to embedded or externally supplied implementations.

decision_site: IR operation to linked runtime symbol
candidate_check: Carry the governing policy or configuration to every decision and cache key that consumes it.
repair_evidence: PR 14246 places musl bitcode linking under options_.linkEmbedded, leaving those symbols for the external static link when the option is false.

represented_relation: HAL buffer views bind tensor shape and type metadata to a byte range of a backing buffer.

candidate_check: Compose every index and offset transformation and compare the resulting physical element or region.
repair_evidence: PR 14232 restricts the fold to a source offset matched by m_Zero and adds a nonzero-offset no-fold regression.

represented_relation: VM register allocation binds multiword SSA values and branch remaps to i32 register-bank slots.

candidate_check: Prove the selected extent and address satisfy allocation bounds, hardware limits, and alignment.
repair_evidence: PR 14332 reserves ceil(bitwidth/32) scratch registers for multiword remaps; PR 17829 makes IREE_VM_VERIFY_REG_ANY reject out-of-range i32 and ref ordinals.

represented_relation: Dispatch result position implicitly determines its associated read-write resource position.

decision_site: dispatch result position to destination storage
candidate_check: Compare logical identity, position, and role with the selected physical entity.
repair_evidence: The pass stops emplacement at the first unemplaceable result, preserving a contiguous result prefix.

represented_relation: Arith-to-SPIR-V conversion binds a logical sub-byte integer to a wider legal SPIR-V carrier and its extension semantics.

candidate_check: Check bit width, signedness, precision, dtype, and packing across each representation change.
repair_evidence: LLVM commit 2b066501 adds masking and logical/arithmetic shifts for emulated integer extension and truncation. Commit 69a3c9cd permits sub-byte vector conversion. IREE PR 14652 imports them and adds the reported ui4-to-f32 end-to-end regression.

represented_relation: IREE bufferization binds HAL binding byte offsets to memref element offsets for packed tensor elements.
repair_relevant_fact: Byte-to-element conversion preserves the physical bit address for sub-byte element types.
candidate_check: Compose every index and offset transformation and compare the resulting physical element or region.
repair_evidence: PR 14647 computes (byte_offset * 8) floor-divided by the exact type bit width, extends bit-width handling to vectors, and checks that 64 bytes becomes memref offset 128 for i4.

represented_relation: The ROCm HAL binds a user-visible UUID path to a HIP device and its execution context.

repair_evidence: PR 15234 publishes GPU UUID paths, parses UUID and index paths, introduces explicit HIP-to-HAL ID conversions, and retains then sets the selected device's primary context.

represented_relation: queue_copy binds a source byte range to capacity in a destination HAL buffer.

repair_evidence: PR 15511 changes the equality check to source_length > target_length and adds tests for smaller-source success and larger-source rejection.

represented_relation: The VM register allocator binds typed SSA references and live intervals to encoded physical register ordinals.

represented_relation: The update connects the computed value to an externally supplied target that may be tied to another value.

represented_relation: PJRT compilation binds a loaded executable to the devices selected in CompileOptionsProto.

represented_relation: The HIP ExportDef binds compiled kernel code to the launch-time dynamic shared-memory amount.

represented_relation: HLO reduce_window binds a logical init operand to each Linalg output-buffer accumulator.

represented_relation: The HIP file-transfer path binds parameter-file chunks to byte ranges in a reusable staging buffer and queued device transfers.

represented_relation: IREE binds a logical tensor extent to a concrete stack allocation through value bounds and byte-size resource checks.

represented_relation: VM result packing binds returned references to caller-frame reference registers.

New runtimes fall back to kernel_name for older VMFBs.

represented_relation: DispatchABI binds a processor-data temporary to an LLVM stack slot and a program point in the generated function.

represented_relation: The Vulkan logical device binds an abstract HAL transfer to a queue lane and a concrete command implementation.

represented_relation: The benchmark input VM list owns tensor buffers allocated by the active HAL session.

candidate_check: Follow owners and references through the last use and verify one matching release.

represented_relation: The VM calling convention and result list bind callee reference registers to caller-owned list elements.

candidate_check: Follow owners and references through the last use and verify one matching release.
repair_evidence: PR 4858 implements reference-aware VM list resize/truncation, switches ref return handling to move semantics where appropriate, resets benchmark outputs, and adds resize tests for refs and variants.

represented_relation: IREE HAL binding identifiers are mapped by compiler and runtime code to the dense argument ABI of a CUDA kernel launch.

decision_site: symbolic binding compression across compiler and runtime
candidate_check: Compare logical identity, position, and role with the selected physical entity.
repair_evidence: Commit 0dbd1ac collects binding identifiers, sorts them, and maps them to dense argument positions during lowering. The CUDA command buffer independently sorts descriptor bindings by identifier and writes their device pointers to consecutive argument slots. The compiler regression uses out-of-order sparse identifiers 4, 0, and 7 with distinct element types to check the resulting argument order.

represented_relation: The SIP ABI binds VM result slots to Python tuple leaves.

candidate_check: Compare logical identity, position, and role with the selected physical entity.
repair_evidence: PR 5347 corrects result retrieval to outputs->Get(ordinal), normalizes ABI sequences to tuples, and adds tuple lengths zero through three plus nested pytree tests.

represented_relation: FuseGlobals maps multiple logical mutable globals into one physical resource and offset layout.

represented_relation: The load/store offsets and strides identify the physical source and destination regions represented by each tensor slice.

represented_relation: IREE binds a HAL executable entry point and workload to a workgroup-count region consumed as the runtime dispatch grid.

candidate_check: Establish completion before access, reuse, or release and retain a schedulable path to completion.
repair_evidence: PR 8877 gives the pthread path a mutex-protected epoch and waiter count; prepare snapshots the epoch, post increments it, and commit waits only while the epoch still equals the captured token.

represented_relation: A HAL buffer stores the allocator used later to deallocate its storage.

represented_relation: MHLOToLinalgOnTensors relates an MHLO public tensor type to its signless internal tensor and returned public tensor type.

represented_relation: A task timepoint binds a multi-wait event to a semaphore across worker resolution and waiter cancellation.

represented_relation: The VM decoder binds compact bytecode addresses to typed host loads under target-platform alignment policy.
